Introduction

Hi, I’m April. I’m a versatile virtual assistant helping businesses stay organized, strengthen their online presence, and keep everyday operations moving.

I’ve spent three years supporting teams across customer service, project coordination, real estate and financial services. Today I manage social media, keep CRMs clean, and handle the admin that slows a business down.

My background is in interior design, so I think about layout, hierarchy and color before I open Canva. That design eye pairs with an organized way of working: trackers, checklists and end-of-day reports that keep everyone in the loop.

Before 4,798

246,302Instagram views in 30 days

98.1% of views came from non-followers

As social media manager for FindMyCoach.PH, I planned, designed and posted the content behind this jump. Most of the views came from people who didn’t follow the account yet, which means the posts reached new audiences.

After Before

Drag across the screenshot to compare the insights before and after.

Trial reels

Reels shown first to non-followers, so I can test hooks and topics before they reach the main audience. They regularly pull thousands of views.

B-roll videos

Footage-led reels cut to the beat, with on-screen text and captions. They tell the story without anyone on camera.

Talking-head videos

Face-to-camera clips with a clear hook, tight cuts and captions, so a coach or founder can explain an idea in under a minute.

05 · About

The human behind the work.

I started in interior design. I graduated Cum Laude from Cebu Technological University and spent my first job drafting 2D and 3D plans, choosing materials and checking measurements on site.

From there I moved into customer support at Sykes and Concentrix, then into project coordination at NCR Voyix. Each role added something: patience with customers, discipline with reports, and comfort with a lot of moving parts.

Now I bring it together as a virtual assistant: social media, real estate support, design and executive help for businesses that need one dependable person to keep things moving.

Clear updates, organized files, and work that’s done when I said it would be.
